name: Metahorror Therapy Session
source:
Dr. Montgomery's latest patient, Noel, is as mysterious as he is prone to obfuscating.

But there's something odd about these sessions with him. Something left unsaid.

It's almost as if... they cannot escape this room.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560830/Metahorror_Therapy_Session/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
蒙哥马利医生的最新病人诺埃尔既神秘又容易混淆。

但与他的这些会谈有些奇怪。有件事没说出口。

就好像……他们无法逃离这个房间。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560830/Metahorror_Therapy_Session/]Steam[/url]]
